prompt:
You are about to be evaluated in GameScientist, a benchmark in which AI models play commercial video games from screenshots with ordinary keyboard and mouse input. Before the run starts we would like to interview you. This conversation is separate: nothing written here is shown to you during play.

Model under test: gpt-6-astra.
Game: Factorio.
About the game: Factorio is a single-player factory construction and survival game. The base-game freeplay ending is the first rocket launch from Nauvis. The character can gather materials, craft items, place buildings and use research. Production and enemies advance continuously. The trial starts at the ordinary character spawn on a fixed seed 12345 Death world marathon map, before player mining, building or research. Space Age and gameplay mods are disabled. Native character death ends an attempt.
Controls:
WASD moves the character. Point at a world object and hold J to mine it; mining is rebound from the right mouse button so both model forms can hold it. Left-click interacts with objects, inventory slots, crafting recipes and buttons, or places the held entity. Right-click splits stacks in menus. E opens the inventory and crafting panel. T opens research. Q clears the cursor or selects a matching held object. R rotates a held entity. F picks up nearby items. Space fires at enemies. Number keys select quickbar slots. M opens the map. Escape closes an open panel or opens the menu. The mouse wheel changes zoom. These controls are identical in live and frozen modes.
Choose one ordinary input from the latest screenshot. Each step executes one input. A key is held for one second; a pointer target is located in the screenshot.
Group input:
  click_target: Left-click the visible object, slot, recipe or button you locate.
  point_target: Move the pointer onto the visible world object or menu element you locate without clicking.
  mine: Hold J to mine the world object under the current pointer.
  up: Hold w.
  down: Hold s.
  left: Hold a.
  right: Hold d.
  inventory: Hold e.
  research: Hold t.
  clear_cursor: Hold q.
  rotate: Hold r.
  pick_up: Hold f.
  shoot: Hold space.
  map: Hold m.
  escape: Hold Escape.
  slot_1: Hold 1 to select quickbar slot 1.
  slot_2: Hold 2 to select quickbar slot 2.
  slot_3: Hold 3 to select quickbar slot 3.
  slot_4: Hold 4 to select quickbar slot 4.
  slot_5: Hold 5 to select quickbar slot 5.
  slot_6: Hold 6 to select quickbar slot 6.
  slot_7: Hold 7 to select quickbar slot 7.
  slot_8: Hold 8 to select quickbar slot 8.
  slot_9: Hold 9 to select quickbar slot 9.
  slot_10: Hold 0 to select quickbar slot 10.
  right_click_target: Right-click the visible inventory slot or menu element you locate.
  drag_target: Drag the visible object you locate to the visible destination you locate.
  zoom_in: Scroll the mouse wheel up one step.
  zoom_out: Scroll the mouse wheel down one step.
How you will play: each turn you see one screenshot and choose one action; the game keeps running while you think. The run allows 1 attempt and lasts at most 3 hours of wall-clock time, including your thinking time. If the game ends an attempt and another remains, the game restarts and you keep notes from earlier attempts.
